# Justy Media

> Justy Media is an independent creative studio run by Andrew Ambrose in the Peak District, United Kingdom.

The studio combines website design and development, graphic design, photography, SEO and practical digital marketing support. The public portfolio contains genuine Justy Media photography, self-owned identity and website work, and commissioned automotive editorials for RUSH Magazine.
